items.title: The Celtics know that when they call Luka Garza's number, even if he has been out of the rotation, they can depend on him.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
The Celtics know that when they call Luka Garza's number, even if he has been out of the rotation, they can depend on him.

Garza knows that, even after the most validating season of his career, he's still fighting for his place in the NBA.

As he does so...1/2
